name: prompt-seed-edit-verify-schema-placeholder
description: When a seed targets prompt text in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/, verify the output-schema placeholder for consistency before editing (fabro-4cd8: line ~156 placeholder was already consistent, no edit needed). Loop-asset edits must go through shell (python heredoc replace asserting count==1); file tools fail on fs_hide paths.

content: Workflow assets stay abstract/project-agnostic: no run ids, PR numbers, shas, dated cost narratives, or machine paths in .fabro/workflows/**; evidence lives in seed Basis lines; facts carriers carry facts, not archaeology. Carrier: fabro-41de extension; user directive 2026-09-16.

iterate/integrate/merge-upstream are EXCLUSIVELY local agent-session skills — never referenced from fabro workflows. Skills for workflow agent stages must be vendored into .fabro/skills/<name>/ in the repo so a run's LLM agent can recognize and load them (precedents: rust-style-guide, improve-codebase-architecture).
